title: Document and prove Vaporize's staged Windows platform-upgrade discipline
createdBy: codex after operator requested a slow, calculated Windows platform upgrade process

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-08-21: operator established WCode as the Windows application lifecycle authority and asked that the Windows upgrade move slowly and deliberately with Bead tracking.
historicalContent.description: Vaporize must document and prove a repeatable Windows platform-upgrade path. swift-win remains the raw Package.swift authority and must reject application artifacts with a WCode next-step pointer. WCode owns application build, run, install, deployment, and custom tooling. The upgrade process must proceed as an evidence-first pilot: preflight the toolchain and Vaporize package, prove authority routing, build one app, run that same app, install it through an explicit WCode lifecycle script, then expand one platform variable at a time.
acceptanceCriteria: Engineering DocC names swift-win as the Package.swift-only authority and WCode as the Windows app lifecycle authority.
The lifecycle script contract documents WCODE_OPERATION, app identity, lifecycle flags, and WCODE_ARGUMENTS_JSON.
The process has ordered preflight, authority, build, run, install, and expansion gates with stated stop conditions.
Focused Windows authority coverage proves WCode owns app build/install/run and swift-win points an app install to the matching WCode operation.
A missing local Vaporize dependency is recorded as a Vaporize preflight blocker rather than misclassified as an app/platform failure.
At least one Windows app pilot records separate build, run, and install evidence before fleet/platform expansion is claimed.
WCode app test support remains explicitly tracked as a follow-up rather than silently invoking an Apple test path.

knownBlockingState.blocker: The focused Vaporize test invocation cannot access its required local swift-log package checkout.
knownBlockingState.requiredNextAction: Restore the declared local dependency, then rerun the focused CUJ-01 test bundle before beginning the pilot application gate.
